# Tacy Medical, Inc.

> > Tacy Medical is a healthcare distribution company specializing in USP795-compliant pharmacy compounding supplies, infusion equipment, and cleanroom products.

Tacy Medical provides comprehensive medical and pharmacy supplies including IV bags, infusion pumps, sterile compounding equipment, and hazardous drug handling safety products. The company serves healthcare facilities with products meeting USP795 standards for sterile and non-sterile compounding.

## Key Topics

- USP795 compliance
- Sterile compounding
- IV infusion equipment
- EVA gravity bags
- Ambulatory infusion pumps
- CritiGear protective equipment
- Hazardous drug handling
- ChemoTest safety testing
- Pharmacy compounding supplies
- Cleanroom equipment
- DEHP-free IV sets
- Needleless connectors
- Luer-activated devices
- Sterile vials and filters
- Healthcare distribution

- [About Tacy Medical](https://www.tacymedical.com/about-tacy-medical): Company overview of Tacy Medical healthcare distribution services
